function.name: requirements.DefineFunc
function.description: Define a Go function or method contract. For a free function, symbol is the function name. For a method on a struct, symbol is "ReceiverType.MethodName".

path.description: Relative path to the Go file that will contain the function, e.g. "./utils/parse/Parse.go"

symbol.description: The linkable symbol. Free function: the function name, e.g. "Parse". Method: "ReceiverType.MethodName", e.g. "structs.Data.Parse". Must match the parsed declaration exactly.

declaration.description: Single-line Go function signature, e.g. "func Parse(input string) (string, error)" or "func (data *structs.Data) Parse(specification *schemas.Input)"

behavior.description: One-line note describing what the function must do.

function.name: requirements.DefineInterface
function.description: Define a Go interface contract. The symbol is the interface type name.

path.description: Relative path to the Go file that will contain the interface, e.g. "./utils/parse/Parser.go"

symbol.description: The interface type name, e.g. "Parser". Must match the parsed declaration exactly.

behavior.description: One-line note describing what implementations of this interface must do.

function.name: requirements.DefineStruct
function.description: Define a Go struct contract. The symbol is the struct type name.

path.description: Relative path to the Go file that will contain the struct, e.g. "./structs/Data.go"

symbol.description: The struct type name, e.g. "Data". Must match the parsed declaration exactly.

behavior.description: One-line note describing what the struct represents and how it must be used.

function.name: requirements.List
function.description: List all previously defined requirements (functions, interfaces and structs) with their file, symbol, declaration and behavior.

function.name: requirements.Search
function.description: Search defined requirements by file path and an optional symbol. Omit symbol to list every requirement in the file.

path.description: Relative path to a file or folder, e.g. "./structs/Data.go" or "./structs"

symbol.description: Optional symbol filter, e.g. "Parse" or "structs.Data.Parse". Omit to list all symbols.
